affected.text: 这个由导体运动引起的有效力沿导体$AB$的方向作用。为计算电动势，将式(12-5)中的有效力沿电荷相对于导体的路程$l$积分，得到：

$A=f\cdot l=|q|vBl\sin\alpha$。

这里的A是电荷相对于导体运动时的有效力积分，不是磁场对载流子沿总位移所做的功。磁力垂直于载流子的总速度，包括随导体运动和在导体内运动这两部分，所以不对载流子做总功。
维持导体$AB$运动的外部机械推动者做功，向电路提供电能。感生电动势等于上述导体相对的有效力积分除以电荷量的大小：
这个公式适用于上述几何条件下，在匀强磁场中以速度$v$运动、长度为$l$的直导体。直杆沿v与B的叉乘方向放置，即同时垂直于v和B；alpha是v与B之间的夹角。
The motion-induced effective force acts along conductor $AB$. For the EMF calculation, integrate the effective force in (12-5) over the charge's displacement $l$ relative to the conductor:

$A=f\cdot l=|q|vBl\sin\alpha$.

Here A is the effective-force integral for motion relative to the conductor, not the total magnetic work on a carrier. The magnetic force is perpendicular to the carrier's total velocity, including motion with and within the conductor, so it does no total work on the carrier.
The external mechanical agent maintaining the motion of conductor $AB$ supplies the electrical energy. The induced EMF is the conductor-relative effective-force integral per unit charge magnitude:

This formula applies to a straight conductor moving at speed $v$ in a uniform magnetic field and having length $l$, under the geometric conditions above. The rod lies along v cross B, perpendicular to both v and B; alpha is the angle between v and B.
